description: Two-diode model with concentration-ratio scaling and CPV thermal model. Based on GaInP/GaInAs/Ge triple-junction architecture at 500x concentration.

module.name: Spectrolab C3MJ+ 500x CPV (Two-Diode Parametrisation)
module.source: Araki & Yamaguchi (2003) Solar Energy Mater.; King et al. (2012) Prog. Photovolt.; Cotal et al. (2009) Energy Environ. Sci.

cells_in_series.note: Single triple-junction cell; module has multiple cells

lens_area.note: Primary Fresnel lens area per cell, ~20x20mm

I_ph_ref.note: 1-sun photocurrent at STC (top sub-cell limited ~16.7 mA/cm2 for 1cm2 cell)

I_01.note: Diffusion saturation current (n1=1); low for III-V due to high material quality

Rs.note: Series resistance (low for concentrated cells; high current)

Rsh_ref.note: Shunt resistance at 1-sun; scales with 1/C at concentration

alpha_sc.note: Short-circuit current temperature coefficient at 1-sun (~+0.1%/K per sub-cell)

Eg_eff.note: Effective bandgap for I_o temperature scaling; approximate for triple junction

NOCT_cpv.note: Nominal Operating Cell Temperature at C_noct concentration

C_noct.note: Concentration at which NOCT is measured

dni.note: Direct Normal Irradiance on primary optics
